changes.evidence: Echo episode 3: after her ancestors' visions lead her to the ambushed Lighthorsemen and she kills the attackers, Tuklo becomes a permanent member of the Lighthorsemen (wiki affiliation: Choctaw, Lighthorsemen).

Daredevil: Born Again S2 episode 8: Rivera brings Fisk the governor's exile deal, Fisk takes it and leaves New York, so his administration ends there. The wiki says she became interim mayor after Fisk's downfall, before Brand New Day (2028), where she is already mayor. The break with Fisk happens in S2, not in Brand New Day.

owner_calls.question: Savva is first mate of Fisk's smuggling ship Northern Star in DDBA S2 episode 1, then flees when it sinks and goes into hiding. Should the record show that crew/employer stage before Independent?
options: [["Fisk's Empire","Daredevil: Born Again S2"],["Independent","Daredevil: Born Again S2"]]
owner_calls.evidence: Wiki: he served as First Mate of the Northern Star, hired to smuggle Fisk's weapons; after it sank he separated from Kyriaco and went into hiding (DDBA201), then testified against Fisk (DDBA204).

owner_calls.question: At the end of Loki S2 Loki leaves the TVA to sit alone on the throne at the end of time, cut off from his friends. Is this a departure from the TVA?
options: Keep TVA as the last stage (wiki still lists TVA as a current affiliation)
owner_calls.evidence: Loki S2 episode 6: Loki destroys the Temporal Loom, climbs to the Citadel throne, and the rift closes, cutting him off. The MCU wiki still lists TVA as his current affiliation.

owner_calls.question: At the end of She-Hulk, Wong frees Blonsky from prison and takes him to live at Kamar-Taj. Does this end his Abomaste stage?
options: Keep Abomaste as the last stage
Add ["Masters of the Mystic Arts","She-Hulk: Attorney at Law"]
owner_calls.evidence: She-Hulk episode 9: Blonsky goes back to prison, then Wong opens a portal and takes him to Kamar-Taj. The wiki lists Abomaste as former and gives no Masters of the Mystic Arts membership.
